newsitem.title: USA: Assisted Living sets split, rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Assisted Living sets split, rights plan.

text.p: Assisted Living Concepts Inc said Friday it had declared a two-for-one stock split and a dividend distribution of one preferred share purchase right for each outstanding common share.

The purchase rights, subject to limited exceptions, will be exercisable if a person or group acquires 15 percent or more of the company's common stock or announces a tender offer for 15 percent or more of the common stock.
Assisted Living said the rights are not being distributed in response to any specific effort to acquire control of the company.
The record date for the stock split and purchase right distribution is June 30. The split will occur immediately prior to the purchase right distribution.
The company expects its common stock to begin trading on a split-adjusted basis on AMEX on or about July 10.
